title: No Halloween strip
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The hardware store has pumpkins. The laundromat has a paper skeleton. Wood announces the strip will not do a Halloween strip. This is the Halloween strip.

panels.composition: Main street in rain, a hardware store with pumpkins on a pallet under the awning, a paper skeleton in the laundromat's window down the block. WOOD walking.

image.prompt: a small-town main street in rain with pumpkins on a pallet under a hardware store awning and a paper skeleton in a laundromat window, black and white, no words

balloons.text: The strip does not do holidays. Holidays are content.

image.prompt: a young man in a wool overcoat talking to himself on a rainy sidewalk, black and white, no words

panels.composition: A KID in a sheet, early, passing him with a pillowcase. Looking up at him.

image.prompt: a small child in a bedsheet ghost costume with a pillowcase looking up at a young man on a sidewalk, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The street. The pumpkins. The skeleton. Wood walking on. The strip has drawn all of it.

image.prompt: a rainy main street with pumpkins and a paper skeleton, a young man walking away with hands in his coat, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: 'Holidays are content.' The strip draws the holiday anyway.
